title: Shorten queue file override drawer title
summary: Updated the Queue per-file override drawer title so it uses the shorter File label and truncates long display names from the beginning of the filename.
reason: Long media filenames often carry release bloat at the end, so preserving the start of the name makes the drawer header easier to identify.
behavior_before: The drawer title rendered as File Settings with an ellipsis plus the last 40 characters of long filenames.
behavior_after: The drawer title renders as File with the first 40 characters of long filenames plus a trailing ellipsis.
rollback_plan: Restore the previous File Settings title text and tail-preserving truncation expression in queue/fileOverrides.drawer.js, then refresh summaries.
notes: Queue file override drawer title now says File and truncates from the filename start.
